items.source: Creates a JacksonHashMapper.JacksonHashMapperBuilder to build a JacksonHashMapper instance using JsonMapper.
items.translation: 创建一个JacksonHashMapper.JacksonHashMapperBuilder，用于通过JsonMapper构建一个JacksonHashMapper实例。

items.source: Creates a new JacksonHashMapper.JacksonHashMapperBuilder to configure and build a JacksonHashMapper.
items.translation: 创建一个JacksonHashMapper.JacksonHashMapperBuilder，用于配置和构建一个JacksonHashMapper。

items.source: Provide a customizer to configure the ObjectMapper through its MapperBuilder.
items.translation: 提供一个customizer，通过其MapperBuilder来配置ObjectMapper。

items.source: Creates a new JacksonHashMapper allowing further configuration through configurer.
items.translation: 创建一个新的JacksonHashMapper，并通过configurer进行进一步配置。

items.source: Provide a PolymorphicTypeValidator to validate polymorphic types during deserialization.
items.translation: 提供一个PolymorphicTypeValidator以在反序列化期间验证多态类型。

items.source: Dedicated support package for Redis hashes.
items.translation: 专为 Redis 哈希类型提供的支持包。

items.source: Use a flattened representation using dot notation.
items.translation: 使用点表示法的扁平化表示。

items.source: Configure whether to flatten the resulting hash using dot notation for properties.
items.translation: 配置是否使用点号表示法将生成的哈希值扁平化。

items.source: Use a hierarchical node structure as created by Jackson.
items.translation: 使用由 Jackson 创建的层次化节点结构。
